scripts.publish:package: echo 'Publishing is disabled: all packages in this repository are private'
scripts.internal:publish:package: echo 'Publishing disabled for this template repository'
scripts.storybook:dev: concurrently -k --names "VUE,REACT,PORTAL" -c "green.bold,magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "pnpm storybook:vue:dev" "pnpm storybook:react:dev" "wait-on tcp:6006 tcp:6007 && pnpm storybook:portal:dev"
scripts.storybook:build: pnpm --filter @components-kit/styles build && pnpm --filter @components-kit/storybook-vue build && pnpm --filter @components-kit/storybook-react build && pnpm --filter @components-kit/storybook-portal build && rm -rf apps/storybook-portal/storybook-static/vue apps/storybook-portal/storybook-static/react && cp -r apps/storybook-vue/storybook-static apps/storybook-portal/storybook-static/vue && cp -r apps/storybook-react/storybook-static apps/storybook-portal/storybook-static/react && touch apps/storybook-portal/storybook-static/.nojekyll
